scope: Incremental retired-battery diagnostics beyond a common de-energisation baseline

evidence_status_definitions.manuscript_value: Value verified in local manuscript or source code; not independently validated for a particular plant.
evidence_status_definitions.manuscript_reported_bounds: Bounds reported in the submitted SI; the original external citation still needs applicability verification.
evidence_status_definitions.analyst_exploratory: Proposed stress or uncertainty range; not a measured industrial distribution.
evidence_status_definitions.derived: Compute from upstream parameters; do not sample independently.
evidence_status_definitions.missing_measurement: Not sampled in the core analysis; disclose omission or analyse a separately labelled threshold scenario.

distribution_policy.triangular_interpretation: A modelling choice favouring a representative value; the mode is not an empirical estimate unless additional evidence is attached.
distribution_policy.shape_robustness: Repeat the same bounded analysis using uniform instead of triangular marginals.
distribution_policy.shared_inputs: The original 15 inputs are shared across methods and retain their old random stream. An independent sixteenth input deployment_rpt_fraction affects Proposed only. p remains the training-label fraction; q is a fraction of the deployment pool, applied after de-energisation. Fixed 6.5% and 15% values remain deterministic sensitivity references.
distribution_policy.regional_inputs: Regional wage, electricity price and grid intensity should be grouped when evidence supports a regional scenario.
distribution_policy.retention_link: Core model uses the same sampled retention for remaining capacity and energy; independent draws are not allowed in this version.
distribution_policy.units: Monetary rates are USD; durations are hours; powers are kW; energy is kWh except cell_energy_Wh.

parameters.source: User confirmed on 2026-09-26: 3-5% of deployment pool, mode 4%, RPT after de-energisation from zero SOC
parameters.role: N_target=q*(1-p)*N. Full zero-SOC RPT adds 1.5 h charge, 10 min rest, r h discharge and E_cell/eta grid energy per target. q is not added to training p. Selected cells use representative batch retention; targeting performance and subgroup distributions are not validated.

parameters.source: SI Note 19 p52
parameters.role: Per-tonne normalisation.

parameters.source: SI Note 19 p52 provides the original 47.5 g centre and 47-48 g range; user expanded the candidate range to 45-50 g on 2026-09-21
parameters.role: Exploratory equivalent-cell mass uncertainty only; varying mass alone does not establish applicability to other cell formats. Fixed at 47.5 g in deterministic sensitivity analysis.

parameters.source: SI Table S22
parameters.role: Change jointly with voltage, mass and protocol when defining a different cell type.

parameters.source: SI Table S22
parameters.role: Representative 18650 value, not the measured voltage specification of the experimental IFR32135 cells.

parameters.source: Original centre: MATLAB method scripts; exploratory triplet set by user on 2026-09-21; bounds require empirical evidence
parameters.role: Shared retention for capacity and energy in the core approximation.

parameters.source: Original centre: avg_soc_init=0.6 in MATLAB scripts; user revised the exploratory triplet to (0.2,0.4,0.6) on 2026-09-22
parameters.role: Batch representative SOC, not a fitted within-batch distribution. The current 0.2-0.6 range lies entirely below the fixed 0.25 partial-charge increment's SOC limit of 0.75. Keep method-specific applicability checks for out-of-range stress scenarios; do not clip SOC or reject shared draws.

parameters.source: User specified triangular (0.05,0.15,0.30) on 2026-09-21; original TEA uses p=0.15 and the experimental training-pool ratio is approximately 6.5%
parameters.role: Deterministic sensitivity scans 0.05-0.30 with 0.065 and 0.15 markers; Monte Carlo samples p jointly with the other 14 inputs and shares p across learning methods. Deployment fraction is 1-p. This is an exploratory budget distribution, not a measured labelling requirement or evidence of equal diagnostic accuracy across budgets.

parameters.source: User-defined batch partition and original TEA workflow
parameters.role: Complement of the labelling fraction; never sample or vary independently.

parameters.source: SI Table S22; user confirmed fixed duration on 2026-09-21
parameters.role: Full 1C CCCV charge from fully discharged state is approximated as 1.5 h, independent of retention. User's CC/CV compensation rationale is a modelling hypothesis, not a verified universal ageing law. Arrival-to-full duration is (1-initial_soc)*1.5 h; do not multiply it by retention or divide it by charge efficiency.

parameters.source: MATLAB Tdis=1, multiplied by retention
parameters.role: Full discharge duration is retention / discharge_C_rate.

parameters.source: Code and protocol tables use 10 min; user confirmed fixed protocol times on 2026-09-21
parameters.role: Use 10 min in both analyses; still reconcile the general SI text that states 15 min. The former exploratory 5-15 min distribution is no longer active.

parameters.source: Original 1 h in Tao and Fan MATLAB scripts; user confirmed fixed protocol times on 2026-09-21
parameters.role: Use 1 h per specified relaxation step for Pulse and EIS in both analyses; no random changes to the measurement protocol.

parameters.source: SI Tables S24-S25
parameters.role: Changing the number of measurements is a protocol/accuracy scenario, not arbitrary stochastic noise.

parameters.source: User specified triangular (0.85,0.90,0.95) on 2026-09-21; no measured efficiency was identified in the current TEA files
parameters.role: Grid charging energy = stored charging energy / efficiency. The proposed centre is not a measured value. Fixed at 0.90 in deterministic sensitivity analysis.

parameters.source: SI Note 19 p53; IRENA reference requires tariff-versus-generation-cost applicability check
parameters.role: Keep region and price year explicit before publication.

parameters.source: SI Note 19 p53
parameters.role: One shared wage across all methods in a draw.

parameters.source: Original centre: SI Table S22; proposed bounds are operational stress assumptions
parameters.role: Continuous value represents a supervision ratio. Integer staffing and handling bottlenecks belong to a separate plant scenario.

parameters.source: SI Table S22
parameters.role: Do not randomly vary channels without a matching tester specification and price.

parameters.source: total_cost_calculation.m
parameters.role: Cancels from current linear cost-per-tonne formula; affects ideal completion time only.

parameters.source: SI Note 19 p54
parameters.role: Quote/specification verification remains necessary; specialised EIS equipment is not automatically included.

parameters.source: SI Note 19 p54
parameters.role: Applied once to capital cost.

parameters.source: SI Note 19 p54
parameters.role: Straight-line amortisation with zero salvage value in the core analysis.

parameters.source: SI Note 19 p54 reports 85%-90% and adopts 90% as baseline; user extended the upper bound to 95% on 2026-09-21. The extension and distribution shape are exploratory, not measured probabilities
parameters.role: Revised symmetric triangular distribution over 85%-95%, with mode and mean 90%. The previous proposal was triangular (0.85,0.90,0.90); uniform 0.85-0.95 is now the same-bound shape-robustness alternative. Life-cycle annual utilisation is used for rate derivation; do not also divide channel-hours by the same factor without a separate model.

parameters.source: SI Eq 45 and Eqs 49-52 use inconsistent annual-versus-rate wording
parameters.role: Core interpretation is a rate uplift excluding separately modelled electricity; annual maintenance is a separate structural scenario.

parameters.source: SI Eqs 45-52 with explicit rate-uplift interpretation
parameters.role: Never independently sample both this rate and all its upstream capital/lifetime drivers.

parameters.source: Original centre: SI Table S22; proposed wide bounds require regional evidence
parameters.role: Hypothetical low-to-high-carbon grid envelope; do not label it an empirical global distribution.

parameters.source: SI Note 19 p54
parameters.role: These bounds span schemes; regionally coherent prices should be reported separately when known.

parameters.source: No measured auxiliary-power data identified
parameters.role: Illustrative 0/1/5 W per occupied channel only; not a manufacturer specification. Apply to both diagnostic and baseline ledgers.

parameters.source: Original MATLAB sums all rest time into test-bench time
parameters.role: A zero fraction moves rest off the tester; it does not mean zero rack, handling or supervision cost. Add those separately or disclose omission.

parameters.source: SI Table S24
parameters.role: Protocol duration changes require a distinct stress scenario and accuracy qualification.

parameters.source: SI Table S25
parameters.role: Separate the number of available EIS channels from charge-discharge channels when evidence is available.

parameters.source: SI Note 23
parameters.role: Must satisfy initial_soc + increment <= 1 and feature-window availability. Nominal 15 min protocol is retained only where its approximation is justified.

parameters.source: SI Table S24 and Tao script; user explicitly retained original fixed conditioning times during execution
parameters.role: Fixed approximate time per SOC conditioning step; not recomputed as SOC increment times retention.

parameters.source: SI Table S24 and Tao script
parameters.role: SOC before the final CCCV top-up; five preceding SOC measurements retained.

parameters.source: SI Table S25 and Fan script; user explicitly retained original fixed conditioning times during execution
parameters.role: Five fixed 0.15 h conditioning steps ending at SOC zero; approximate duration, not a state-consistent nominal-1C calculation.

parameters.source: SI Table S25 and Fan script
parameters.role: Broad-range EIS at each of five SOC points; distinct from 5 min rapid deployment EIS.

parameters.source: SI Table S26 and Zhou script; user explicitly retained original fixed times during execution
parameters.role: Fixed 15 min feature segment with 25% energy/SOC increment; approximate independent time and energy accounting, not exact nominal-1C scaling.

parameters.source: SI Table S26 and Zhou script; user explicitly retained original fixed times during execution
parameters.role: Fixed 15 min discharge of newly added charge; full baseline discharge still scales as initial_soc*retention.

parameters.source: No training/inference energy measurement in existing TEA
parameters.role: Measure or perform a separately labelled break-even overhead analysis; do not invent a measured baseline.

parameters.source: No dedicated EIS price or channel count in current TEA
parameters.role: The shared tester-rate approximation remains an explicit limitation until this is specified.

parameters.source: Training-pool headline does not enumerate industrial validation labels
